title: Miguel Yu — from Title Defense to Proposal Defense, Final Defense and graduation eligibility
owner: Student, Faculty adviser, GS Staff, Research Coordinator, Panel Chair
duration: 25 min (or show a few screens; each defense needs about two minutes of waiting)
story: After Miguel Yu's Title Defense package is endorsed and his panel is chosen ({case:research_title}, {case:panel_matching}), the research lifecycle continues through four stages in the same Research Gate: Title Defense, Proposal Defense, Final Defense and Completion. Each stage unlocks only when the one before it has a passing result recorded by the panel chair. This case follows Miguel through all of them and ends where the Graduation screen lists him as eligible.

Scheduling and verdict screens are the subject of {case:defense-scheduling}; here they are used with the minimum of steps to move Miguel forward. The system only accepts a verdict after the defense has started and refuses a slot in the past, so each defense was booked for a slot that starts about two minutes after the booking (using the staff warning override for the 14-day lead time, with a recorded reason) and the panel chair submitted the verdict once the start time had passed. Outside the panelists' entered hours (weekdays 08:00 to 17:00) this shortcut is not possible.
accounts: Miguel Yu: uploads the documents of each stage
Books the defenses, runs Panel Matching, verifies the requirements
Dr. Liwayway Bautista: signs the uploaded manuscripts and endorsements in the Faculty Portal
Dr. Marlon Geronimo: submits the Title Defense verdict
Dr. Patricia Salvador: submits the Proposal and Final Defense verdicts
Dr. Sofia Mendoza: records the ethics clearance (Form 5.2)
data: Miguel Yu, 2260004, MAED (reset first; the title package, adviser and panel come from the previous cases)
Chair Dr. Marlon Geronimo, Content Dr. Patricia Salvador, Method Dr. Daniel Uy (Dr. Teodoro Ramos, the suggested method specialist, was already booked in another defense at the same time)
Chair Dr. Patricia Salvador, Content Dr. Celeste Tan, Method Dr. Daniel Uy, External Dr. Adriana Santos (chosen by staff in Panel Matching)

Small demonstration PDFs with realistic names, for example Yu_Miguel_Proposal_Manuscript.pdf, Yu_Miguel_Form4_Endorsement_for_Proposal_Defense.pdf, Yu_Miguel_Form5-2_Ethics_Clearance.pdf, Yu_Miguel_Final_Defense_Manuscript.pdf, Yu_Miguel_Turnitin_Certificate_SIR_11.pdf
Title Defense: Approved, with the title taken from the three submitted; Proposal Defense: Passed; Final Defense: Passed with evaluation score 92 (Form 7)
Status Cleared, dated the day of the demonstration

parts.title: Part A — Title Defense: schedule and verdict

steps.text: Sign in as **staff@usls.edu.ph**, open **6 · Defense Scheduling**, search **2260004** and select **Miguel Yu**. Confirm under **Student readiness** that the stage is Title Defense, that Form 1, the concept papers and the Academic Coordinator endorsement are complete, and that the three panel members show their invitation status Accepted.

shots.caption: Defense Scheduling for Miguel Yu: readiness of the Title Defense stage and the matched panel.

steps.text: In **Final schedule** enter today's date, a start time about two minutes from now and an end time two hours later, mode On-site, venue GS Conference Room. A yellow box **Needs a reason** says that a Title Defense needs at least 14 days after the Form 1 endorsement (earliest 2026-10-15). Tick **Warning override** and write the reason ("Demonstration run: booked the same day so that the verdict can follow"). The green box shows **No conflicts found** when every panelist is free.

shots.caption: Booking form with the lead-time warning and the staff override.

steps.text: Click **Set defense schedule**. Confirm the message "Saved. The student record, queue, and monitoring indicators were updated." The form now says that the stage is already booked, and a schedule history is kept.

shots.caption: The Title Defense is booked.

steps.text: When the start time has passed, sign in as the panel chair **marlon.geronimo@usls.edu.ph** and open **Verdicts**. Confirm that Miguel Yu's Title Defense card lists the Form 1 and the three concept papers as the papers of this stage, and that the block **Submit panel chair verdict** is open (before the start time the card says "The defense has not started yet").

shots.caption: The panel chair's verdict form for the Title Defense.

steps.text: Keep the verdict result **Approved** (the first option for a title defense), write the remark "Title approved as submitted." and type the title chosen by the panel from the three submitted into **Title selected by the panel**. Click **Submit final verdict**.

shots.caption: Verdict form filled in.
The recorded verdict: Approved, with the selected title, who submitted it and when; a correction box is open until someone acts on it.

steps.text: Sign in as the student and open **Research**. The automatically detected stage is now **Proposal Defense**: the Title Defense tile is complete.

shots.caption: Miguel's Research page after the passing verdict: Proposal Defense is the current stage.

parts.title: Part B — Proposal Defense requirements, panel, schedule and verdict

steps.text: On the student's Research page read the cards under **Files you upload** for the Proposal Defense: **Proposal manuscript**, **Proposal defense endorsement**, **Statistical consultation form or qualitative exemption** and **Proposal manuscript endorsement**. Two more cards, **Form 5.1 Technical Review Certificate** and **Research Protocol Form 5.2 ethics clearance**, say "Opens after the proposal defense is passed". The block "Completed by staff or the system" lists the panel assignment, the confirmed schedule, the defense result and the ethics clearance record, all Pending.

shots.caption: Research page at the start of the Proposal Defense stage.

steps.text: Upload one PDF in each of the four cards. Each card then reads 1 of 1 file uploaded; the manuscript and endorsements show that the assigned adviser must sign the exact uploaded file.

shots.caption: The four proposal documents uploaded.

steps.text: Click **Submit Proposal Defense for review**. Confirm "Submitted. Research staff will review your application." and the page status Awaiting Review.

shots.caption: Proposal Defense package submitted.

steps.text: Sign in as the adviser (**liwayway.bautista@usls.edu.ph**) and open **Signatures & Endorsements**. The list shows the documents of all her advisees; Miguel's three unsigned documents (proposal manuscript, Form 4 endorsement, proposal manuscript endorsement) carry the badge Needs signature. Select one: the panel on the right asks you to review the exact file and sign it.

shots.caption: The adviser's signature list.

steps.text: Draw a signature on the pad, click **Finalize signature**, then **Sign this document**. Repeat for the other two documents. After each one the message "Document signed successfully." appears. (The statistical form is not signed by the adviser.)

shots.caption: Signature drawn and finalized for Yu_Miguel_Proposal_Manuscript.pdf.
Document signed successfully.

steps.text: As GS Staff open **4 · Research Gate**, select Miguel Yu and read the Proposal Defense requirements (stage Proposal Defense, 0 completed and 10 pending before verification).

shots.caption: Research Gate record for the Proposal Defense.

steps.text: Click **Verify submitted requirements**. The four uploaded documents show **Verified**; the panel assignment is still Pending panel matching and the schedule and result are pending.

shots.caption: Proposal documents verified; panel, schedule and result still open.

steps.text: Open **5 · Panel Matching** for Miguel Yu. The source is now the **Proposal manuscript** (1 of 1 PDFs read) with the same similarity method, and the panel needs **4 members**: Panel Chair, Content Specialist, Method Specialist and External Panel (the external member joins from the proposal stage). Dr. Liwayway Bautista is again excluded as adviser.

shots.caption: Panel Matching for the Proposal Defense: manuscript read, four seats needed.

steps.text: Read the ranking: rank 1 **Dr. Patricia Salvador 87.2/100** (60/60, 17.2/25, 10/15, suggested Panel Chair), rank 2 Dr. Teodoro Ramos 66.2/100 (52.1/60, 14.1/25, 0/15, flagged Overloaded, suggested Method Specialist), rank 3 **Dr. Celeste Tan 61.6/100** (32.5/60, 14.1/25, 15/15, suggested Content Specialist), rank 4 Dr. Paolo Navarro 46.1/100 (suggested External Panel). The ranking differs from the one for the concept papers because the text read is different.

shots.caption: Ranked candidates read from the proposal manuscript.

steps.text: Keep Dr. Salvador as **Panel Chair**, choose Dr. Celeste Tan (#3, 61.6/100) as **Content Specialist**, Dr. Daniel Uy (#8, 41.2/100) as **Method Specialist** and Dr. Adriana Santos (#9, 35.3/100) as **External Panel**; the suggested method and external members already had another defense booked at the time of the run. Click **Finalize selected panel**; the badge changes to Final panel selected. The four panelists accept their invitations in the Faculty Portal.

shots.caption: Four seats chosen.
Final panel selected (the button now reads Update final panel).

steps.text: Open **6 · Defense Scheduling**, select Miguel Yu and confirm the readiness block (Proposal Defense; manuscript, endorsements and panel assignment complete; Form 5.1 and ethics clearance "Opens after the proposal defense is passed"). Enter the same-day slot as before, fill **Date the panel received the manuscript** (a date 20 days back), and read the green line **No conflicts found (5 of 5 checked, counting the adviser)**. Tick the warning override with its reason and click **Set defense schedule**.

shots.caption: Defense Scheduling for the Proposal Defense.
Booking form for the Proposal Defense.
Proposal Defense booked.

steps.text: As the panel chair **patricia.salvador@usls.edu.ph** open **Verdicts**. The Proposal Defense card lists the four proposal documents. Keep **Passed**, add the remark "Proposal approved." and click **Submit final verdict**. The card now reads "Verdict: Passed".

shots.caption: Chair's verdict form for the Proposal Defense.
Passed selected, remark written.
Verdict recorded: Passed.

parts.title: Part C — Form 5.1, ethics clearance (Form 5.2) and the end of the Proposal stage

steps.text: As the student open **Research**. The cards **Form 5.1 Technical Review Certificate** and **Research Protocol Form 5.2 ethics clearance** are now open for upload, the proposal defense result reads Passed and the page status is Missing Requirements. Upload Yu_Miguel_Form5-1_Technical_Review_Certificate.pdf and Yu_Miguel_Form5-2_Ethics_Clearance.pdf. Both show Submitted for review; "Ethics clearance status and date" waits for the Research Coordinator.

shots.caption: Research page after the passing verdict.
Form 5.1 and Form 5.2 uploaded.

steps.text: Sign in as the Research Coordinator (**research@usls.edu.ph**), open **4 · Research Gate** for Miguel Yu and scroll to the ethics card. Choose **Clearance status = Cleared**, set **Clearance date** and click **Record ethics clearance**. The card shows "Cleared on" with the date, and the record "Ethics clearance status and date" is complete.

shots.caption: The Research Coordinator records the ethics clearance.
Clearance recorded.

steps.text: As GS Staff click **Verify submitted requirements** again. The progress tiles show **Title Defense** and **Proposal Defense** Complete and **Final Defense** as the current stage with 0 of 4 requirements complete.

shots.caption: Proposal Defense complete; Final Defense is next.

steps.text: As the student open **Research**. The stage is **Final Defense**: the panel (Salvador, Tan, Uy, Santos) carries over from the proposal and is shown on the Adviser and panel card. Upload **Final defense manuscript** and **Final defense endorsement** and click **Submit Final Defense for review**. The manuscript card shows the badge Pending adviser signature.

shots.caption: Research page at the Final Defense stage with the panel.
Final documents uploaded.
Final Defense package submitted.

steps.text: As the adviser open **Signatures & Endorsements**, select each of Miguel's two final documents, draw a signature, finalize it and click **Sign this document**.

shots.caption: Signature list with the final documents waiting.
Signing the final defense endorsement.
Document signed successfully.

steps.text: As GS Staff open **4 · Research Gate**, select Miguel Yu (current stage Final Defense, Awaiting Review) and click **Verify submitted requirements**. The two documents show Verified; the confirmed final defense schedule and the final defense result stay pending.

shots.caption: Final Defense record before verification.
Final documents verified.

steps.text: Open **6 · Defense Scheduling** and book the Final Defense as before (same-day slot, manuscript receipt date, warning override with its reason). The panel is the one carried over, with **No conflicts found (5 of 5 checked)** counting the adviser.

shots.caption: Defense Scheduling at the Final Defense stage.
Booking form for the Final Defense.
Final Defense booked.

steps.text: As the panel chair open **Verdicts**. For a final defense the form has an extra field **Evaluation score (Form 7, optional)** with the hint "Below 85 thesis / 90 dissertation cannot be a pass". Keep **Passed**, write "Final defense passed.", enter **92** and click **Submit final verdict**.

shots.caption: Verdict form for the Final Defense with the evaluation score field.
Passed, remark and score 92 entered.
Final Defense verdict recorded: Passed.

parts.title: Part E — Completion evidence and graduation eligibility

steps.text: As the student open **Research**. The stage is now **Completion** (Missing Requirements). Upload the five completion documents: **Final manuscript for archiving**, **Panel approval confirmations**, **Turnitin certificate (SIR 15% or below)**, **Form 9 editor certification** and **Form 10 approval sheet**, then click **Submit Completion for review**. The Turnitin percentage is not read from the file; staff check the certificate.

shots.caption: Completion stage, nothing uploaded yet.
Completion documents uploaded.
Completion package submitted.

steps.text: As GS Staff open **4 · Research Gate**, select Miguel Yu and click **Verify submitted requirements**. All four tiles (Title Defense, Proposal Defense, Final Defense, Completion) read Complete, with 5 completed and 0 pending requirements.

shots.caption: Completion verified: all four research stages complete.

steps.text: Open **8 · Graduation**. Under "Academically Eligible — Awaiting Student Application" Miguel Yu (2260004 · MAED) is listed with Coursework completed, Thesis / research completed, Practicum not required and **Eligible for graduation**. He cannot be put in a graduation batch until he submits the signed application in the student portal.

shots.caption: Graduation list: Miguel Yu academically eligible, awaiting the student's application.

steps.text: As the student open **Graduation**. The page shows "Monitoring eligibility recommendation: Eligible, no missing requirements are currently flagged", and the application step (signed PDF) still has to be submitted by the student. The batch, Dean endorsement and export steps are covered in the graduation case.

shots.caption: Student's Graduation page: eligible; the signed application is the next step.

notes: Each stage unlocks only after the previous stage has a passing result from the panel chair. A failed or deferred verdict keeps the student at the same stage and asks for resubmission or a re-defense.
The advisers sign the exact uploaded file in the system; replacing a manuscript sends the new file back to the adviser. The statistical consultation form is not an adviser signature item.

To reach these screens in one sitting the three defenses were booked for the same day with the staff warning override for the 14-day lead time (the reason is recorded with the schedule). Past slots and double-booked panelists cannot be overridden: in this run the suggested method and external panelists were already in another defense, so other faculty were seated.

Verdict words differ by stage: the Title Defense options start with Approved; proposal and final start with Passed. The evaluation score on the Final Defense verdict is optional and a score below the thesis or dissertation minimum cannot be a pass.
The files uploaded here are small demonstration PDFs; no document content is graded. Graduation batch creation, Dean endorsement and export are not part of this case.
No e-mail is sent by these steps.
